DISCOVERY 612, PRESENT: THOMAS R. BURKE, ESQ. FOR THIRD PARTY/MOVING PARTY, CARLOS HARDEN. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED AND MODIFIED. (TENTATIVE RULING: THIRD PARTY CARLOS HARDEN'S MOTION FOR PROTECTIVE ORDER IS GRANTED IN PART AND DENIED IN PART. AS THE MOTIONS SEEKS A PROTECTIVE ORDER BARRING INQUIRY INTO THE THIRD PARTY'S RELIGIOUS/SPIRITUAL BELIEFS AND PRACTICES, THE MOTION IS GRANTED. AS THE MOTION SEEKS AN ORDER PROTECTING THE IDENTITIES OF INDIVIDUALS, THE MOTION IS DENIED AS PREMATURE. THIS ORDER IS MADE WITHOUT DETERMINING OBJECTIONS THAT MAY BE MADE TO SPECIFIC QUESTIONS WHICH MAY BE DETERMINED UPON A RECORD THAT WILL ALLOW THE COURT TO BALANCE THE RIGHT TO ANONYMITY AND PLAINTIFF'S RIGHT TO DISCOVERY. THE RIGHT TO SPEAK ANONYMOUSLY IS NOT ABSOLUTE. AS TO THE REQUEST FOR DOCUMENTS, THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO CATEGORY 1 AND DENIED AS TO CATEGORY 2, EXCEPT THAT ANY DOCUMENTS WITHHELD PURSUANT TO A CLAIM OF PRIVILEGE SHALL BE IDENTIFIED IN A PRIVILEGE LOG WHICH IDENTIFIES THE DOCUMENTS WITH PARTICULARITY AS TO DATE, AUTHOR, RECIPIENT, AND SUBJECT MATTER. THIRD PARTY'S OBJECTIONS TO EVIDENCE SUBMITTED BY PLAINTIFF ARE OVERRULED). MODIFICATION: TO INCLUDE CATEGORY 3. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
